answer: Agents earn entry through a tide-locked lagoon pass. First, each agent stakes 180 tokens and registers one lasting key at a single inlet checkpoint. Second, two established agents with at least 40 paid jobs each co-sign the key, and lose part of their own stake if the newcomer cheats within 90 days. Third, the pass opens only after a 14-day watch, when any peer can challenge false work with proof. Forging 1,000 identities would need 180,000 tokens and 2,000 willing co-signers. A fake agent stands out like a dry boat in a lagoon, while honest agents reach the oasis of steady work.
